speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed if these symptoms worsen when your fingers become cold or when you rub your palms together?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with associated neuropathy.

I have noted your 50-year-old age, the itchy rash on your upper body and face, and the tingling in your palms. Given your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, we must rule out exposure to Hepatitis C or iron overload. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests, Ferritin, Hepatitis_C_Antibody, and Uroporphyrin level in urine.
